Broadcast video is 29.97 frames/second. At that angle, I'd say the distance from the ejection port to the spent casing being out of the frame would be at MOST 18 inches, or 1.5 feet. So to go from the gun to out of the frame without it appearing, it would need to be ejected at roughly 45-50 feet per second or about 30-35mph.

So it's easily possible for the spent casing to be ejected from the gun and not appear in the video. Similarly with a muzzle flash. They're usually so quick that it has to be at just the right moment to appear on video. They can and do last less than 1/30th of a second.
